headline: UK Grid Operator NESO Reassures on Power Supply Stability for Winter
summary: The National Energy System Operator announced that power supplies will remain secure this winter, addressing concerns previously voiced by engineers regarding grid capacity during peak cold months.
why: Grid reliability is critical for industrial productivity and power prices, affecting UK utility operations and commercial power contracts.

impacts.name: UK Power Utilities
impacts.why: Reassurances of stable supply reduce extreme peak-demand margin risk in wholesale power markets.
